items.title: Health benefits platform Thatch reaches $1B valuation as healthcare costs surge
items.summary: Thatch helps employers keep healthcare costs manageable by offering an individual plan marketplace through an Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement — a model that lets companies fund employees' own individual insurance plans instead of enrolling everyone in one company-wide plan.

items.title: Thatch Announces $108M Financing Round
